items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Mazie, and in the field he was going to give me a captain's rating, and I didn't want to go.

ctx.x: Yeah, they offered me captain's rating. They wanted me to take three months training to protect myself, and here was a girl -- Mazie, wasn't it? Mazie, and in the field he was going to give me a captain's rating, and I didn't want to go. I didn't want to go overseas. I didn't want to travel overseas at all.

So we didn't let the band know it until they got ready to leave, and I came down, the first one I saw was Ina Hutton. Well, here's Eddie, he's -- oh, yeah, no, I would have been in there playing with him because I went everywhere he went when I was in that band, all the time I was with him. Went everywhere he went.
